Commentary.Commentary: Gautam Gambhir is injured so the word is that Cheteshwar Pujara will open along with Murali Vijay. India will look to bat at least till Tea tomorrow and set up a target close to 500. Stay tuned for the third innings.

It was a tough morning session for India but after that, Ashwin found his rhythm and just ran through the batting order. He finished with 6 wickets to his name, his 20th 5-wicket haul in just 39 Tests. Superb effort. The pacers were not that effective in this Test but it did not actually matter much.

To be honest, it was not a bad batting display by the Kiwis. The openers did well but then the middle order fell apart. Then they had a partnership in the lower middle order but once that was broken, another collapse happened. Guptill, Latham and Neesham were impressive but that century is still eluding them. More importantly, their skipper Kane Williamson has not been able to strike the right chord.

So it took India 22.2 overs after Tea to dismantle New Zealand. They needed 4 wickets and got them pretty quickly, even though they conceded some runs. Santner was dismissed half an hour after Tea and then a procession ensued. Eventually, the visitors fell one short of 300, conceding a massive lead of 258.
Murali Vijay is running to the dressing room while the others are slowly walking back. Don't see India enforcing follow-on with that attitude. In fact, THE HOSTS WILL BAT AGAIN.

New Zealand now trail by 341 runs with just 4 wickets in hand. They may not be able to save the follow-on but doubt whether Kohli will enforce it as he might want to give some rest to his bowlers. The second new ball is due in 12 overs' time, so India will look to wrap up the tail as quickly as possible. Join us at 1430 IST (0900 GMT) for the final session.

Neesham and Watling stitched a counter-attacking half century stand but the latter was dismissed just before Tea. Neesham is looking good out there, mixing caution with aggression, albeit he has been lucky on a couple of occasions as well.

India came out firing after Lunch. Mainly, Ravichandran Ashwin who picked up 4 wickets and demolished the Kiwi middle order. The ball to dismiss Kane Williamson was a beauty and Ashwin also played a role in running out Guptill who was playing beautifully.
SESSION HIGHLIGHTS - 91/5 in 29 overs. Good run rate maintained by New Zealand but look at the wickets lost. Again, they have missed to capitalize the initiative and have their backs to the wall.

Another treatment for Guptill. He is suffering from cramps or he has pulled a muscle as he really stretched after playing the shot on the previous ball.
FOUR LEG BYES! On middle and leg, turning down the leg side, Guptill tries to sweep but the ball goes off the gloves to the fine leg region. The umpire signals four leg byes.
Flighted on off, Guptill defends it solidly off his front foot.
Taylor goes back in his crease and defends it down.
Landed around the off stump, Taylor defends it solidly.
Umesh pitches it up and on the stumps line, Taylor tries to play but misses and gets hit on the pads. There is an appeal for a leg before but the umpire says not out as the ball was going down leg.
Down the leg side, Guptill tries to clip but misses. The keeper fails to stop the ball as well and the batsmen take a bye.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Length ball outside off, Guptill defends it off his back foot.
ROSS TAYLOR is the next man in.

OUT! BOWLED 'EM! Tad short outside off, turning in, Williamson goes onto his back foot to play it to the off side but gets an inside edge onto his stumps. That's a big, big wicket for India as the Kiwi skipper departs. That's three in three innings for Ashwin, he has taken his wicket every time in this series. That turn did him in.
Landed around off, Williamson flicks it to mid-wicket.

Appeal for an LBW! Around off, turning in, it stays low after landing, Williamson goes for the pull but gets a bit of an inside edge onto his pads. The ball goes to the off side where Saha dives to his right to stop the ball. The umpire turns down the appeal.
Full around off, Kane strides forward and flicks it to mid-wicket.
Fullish outside off, stays a touch low, Williamson taps it to the off side off his back foot.
Flighted outside off, Williamson goes back in his crease and pushes it towards mid on.
Outside off, MG blocks it out off his front foot.
Landed around off, Guptill defends it into the ground.
FOUR! Nice shot! Fuller length ball outside off, Guptill drives it through the extra cover region. Ashwin chases the ball but he's not quick enough to stop it. Guptill gets a boundary.
Fuller length ball outside off, Williamson drives it towards covers where Gambhir misfields. Parries the ball to mid off and the batsmen take a single.
Good length ball around off, Williamson pushes it to the mid off region.
Length ball on off, Williamson defends it back to the bowler.
Virat Kohli is back on the field. That means Rahane will be back to being vice captain in his presence.
Flighted around off, Martin covers the line and defends.
The batsman gets an inside edge and the ball hits him on the pads.
Landed outside off, Guptill defends it solidly.
Full outside off, defended watchfully by Guptill.
Flighted ball outside off, Guptill tries to defend but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Landed around off, Guptill gets onto his front foot and defends.
Virat Kohli is off the field. Ajinkya Rahane will be leading India in his absence. Shardul Thakur comes on as a substitute.
Fuller length ball outside off, Kane drives it towards the mid off fielder.
Angles it down the leg side, Williamson tries to flick but misses.
Fullish ball outside off, Williamson drives it towards mid off.

FOUR! Soft hands! Length ball outside off, Kane plays it very late and guides it to the third man region. The ball goes past the fence through the gap between first slip and gully and Williamson gets a boundary.
Landed around the off stump line, Williamson defends it into the ground.
Starts with a fuller length ball around off, Williamson covers the line and defends.
We are back for the afternoon session! Kane Williamson and Martin Guptill walk back to the crease. Umesh Yadav to bowl. Here we go...
...Day 3, Session 2...

India will look to come back harder in the afternoon session and should find a plan to take wickets on a pitch which is still good to bat on. Join us back in a bit for the second session then to catch the action.

Martin Guptill is still batting out there and he's looking good. He was under pressure and he couldn't find a better time to score runs. There's a lot of work to be done though for the Kiwis. They are still trailing by 432 runs and would be looking for a similar session ahead.

Pretty good session for New Zealand, that! Scored 97 runs for the loss of one wicket in 30 overs. They added 118 runs for the opening wicket after the openers struck fifties. Guptill and Latham survived some scares initially as Rahane put down one catch and then Jadeja failed to take a tough chance. Latham was out after his fifty when Ashwin got the breakthrough for India eventually.

Full and outside off, Guptill gets his big right leg forward and pads it away. Wriddhiman Saha puts in an LBW appeal and then Ashwin supports him but umpire Dharmasena takes off the bails instead. The ball was not coming back enough. LUNCH ON DAY 3, NEW ZEALAND TRAIL BY 432!
And now the skipper goes back and whips it through mid-wicket for a run.
Full and outside off, deliberately slowed through the air, Kane is beaten as he comes forward a bit too early but still adjusts well and pushes the ball towards first slip. Awesome batting.
Finally he gets off strike. Goes back and flicks it through square leg for a single.
Ashwin comes around the wicket now. Guptill marks a new leg stump guard.
Full and around off, defended watchfully.
Full and outside off, Guptill goes back and flicks it uppishly, just wide of the close-in fielders, towards mid-wicket, who is a bit deep.
Well, Williamson tried his absolute best to help Martin Guptill out by delaying the over as much as possible. But we will still have one more over before Lunch. Meanwhile, long on comes up to mid on.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman.
Full again, another forward block.
Full and outside off, again he comes forward, picks the length quickly and pushes it towards cover.

Quicker through the air, a bit flatter as well, Williamson goes back and punches it towards covers. The good thing with Williamson is that he is not committed onto the front foot. He is quickly able to transfer his weight onto the back foot.
Landed around off, pushed towards covers.
Full and on middle, pushed back to the bowler.
On middle and off, worked straight to short mid-wicket.
Full and around off, watchfully pushed back to the bowler once more.
Flighted outside off, pushed back to the bowler.
Full and outside off, driven back to the bowler.
Full and outside off, Guptill lunges to defend but gets a thick inside edge onto his pads.
Full on off, Williamson comes forward, then goes back and whips it through mid-wicket for a single.

Another impromptu drinks break. Looks like Martin Guptill is struggling with the heat. Umpire Kumar Dharmasena comes over and asks them to hurry up. New Zealand would be feeling like an employee who has been asked to come to work by his/her boss even if he/she is suffering from fever. An ice pack is placed on Guptill's neck. Just a few minutes more to Lunch. Looks really drained out there.
"Solid as a rock," says Laxman Sivaramakrishnan on air as Guptill defends it towards silly point once more.
Good flight around off, MG plays an assured-looking forward defensive shot.
Full on middle and leg, pushed towards the man under the lid on the off side once more.
Full and around off, blocked towards silly point.
Darted into the right-hander, Martin defends watchfully.
Full and outside off, Guptill drives it past Virat Kohli at short extra cover. By the time Umesh Yadav can get to the ball from long off to his left, the batsmen take a couple.
Full on middle, dipping onto the batsman, Martin flicks it through mid-wicket for a run. Successful over for India then, just at the stroke of Lunch.
Full and around off, pushed forward towards point.
Landed outside off, defended solidly.
Full on middle, flicked wide of mid-wicket for a very quick single to get off the mark.
KANE WILLIAMSON walks out to bat.

OUT! Caught and bowled! Ashwin has broken through! So the turned down catch appeal has not cost India at all. Just one run added after that and it should not matter much. Good loop from the experienced off spinner, slows the pace a touch, Latham looks to flick but is a slight early into the same. As a result, he gets a leading edge which lobs back to the bowler who calmly takes it. No doubt this time. Latham walks. End of a very good opening stand. Now the big question - Will the floodgates open up? 240 MORE NEEDED TO AVOID THE FOLLOW-ON.
Full and around off, well defended.
Full and outside off, pushed to the off side.
Very full on middle, almost a yorker, Guptill somehow digs it out.
Now a proper paddle is played down to fine leg and he gets a single.

APPEAL FOR A CATCH! TURNED DOWN. Jadeja looks frustrated. Full and outside off, Latham reaches out to paddle but misses and the ball goes off his pads to first slip where Ajinkya Rahane takes it. Oh dear... replays show that Latham hit that onto his boot and it lobbed up. Lucky. Perhaps the umpire was not sure about the inside edge, else he would have referred it upstairs whether the ball hit the ground first.
Shorter in length, around off, Latham stays back to punch it to the bowler.
On middle and leg, flicked straight to short mid-wicket.
More drinks for the batsmen. Umpire Bruce Oxenford quietly has a word with them and asks to hurry up a bit.
Around off, defended towards short mid-wicket.
Full once more, defended watchfully.
Very full, driven back to the bowler who parries it back onto the stumps.
Full again, flicked straight to short mid-wicket.
Full and outside off, defended towards short mid-wicket.
Full on middle and off, Latham reaches out and sweeps it fine for a single.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot. They pick up a single.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
FOUR! Fine knock. On middle, Latham goes back and works it through square leg and gets a boundary. What an opening stand this has been. 10th Test fifty for Tom Latham!
Another LBW appeal, turned down again Tom lunges to block but gets a thick inside edge onto his pads.
On middle, Latham looks to defend but misses and is hit on the pads. An LBW appeal ensues but that was going down the leg side.
Full on middle, flicked through mid-wicket where Virat Kohli dives to his left and stops it. Brilliant effort.
Full and outside off again, well kept out.
Full and outside off, well defended.
Comes forward and pushes it to mid on for a single.
On middle and leg, worked towards short mid-wicket.
Full on middle, defended back to the bowler.
FOUR BYES! Down the leg side, Latham misses his flick and a blinded Wriddhiman Saha misses the ball. It races to the fine leg fence. 248 more needed to avoid the follow-on.
Change of gloves for the batsmen.
FOUR! Lovely shot. Tossed up outside off, Guptill leans and lofts it over extra cover. Ravichandran Ashwin is at long off and he runs to his left but cannot cut it off.
Full and outside off, well kept out.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Interesting from Guptill. Every now and then, he walks away from the strike, keeping Jadeja waiting.
Full and outside off, Guptill defends it towards point.
On the stumps now, punched back to the bowler.
Short and outside off, punched towards cover.
FOUR! Sweet! Overpitched on middle, Latham comes forward and drives it through mid on. Ravindra Jadeja is pretty wide and cannot cut it off! 12 from the over. 100 UP FOR NEW ZEALAND! Good start.
Fuller this time, watchfully blocked out.

FOUR! Outstanding shot. Fractionally short in length, around middle, Latham goes back and whips it uppishly through mid-wicket and finds the boundary. Moves to 41. 260 more needed to avoid the follow-on,
Full and outside off, watchfully kept out.

EDGED, FOUR! Beautiful bowling. Ashwin tosses this up, slows the pace, forces Latham to come forward and even induces the outside edge. But it goes wide of first slip and races away to the third man fence. Murali Vijay gives it a chase from backward point and slides near the fence but in vain.
Full on middle, driven towards short extra cover.
Full and outside off, solidly defended.
FOUR! Audacious! Short and outside off, Guptill goes back and punches it through covers for a very important boundary in terms of personal gains. He brings up his 17th Test fifty!
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot.
EDGED, SAFE! Full and outside off, Martin comes forward to defend but gets a thick outside edge which does not carry to first slip. Soft hands.

WATCH WHERE YOU ARE GOING, MATE! Nervous moment for Guptill. He drives it towards short extra cover where Virat Kohli misfields and parries it behind. Guptill comes halfway down the track for the single but Latham calmly sends him back. MG has to hurry back and he does so in time, before Jadeja can fire a throw to the keeper.
An LBW appeal but nothing in it. Full on middle, Guptill stays leg side of the ball and looks to defend but misses and is hit on the pads. Going down the leg side.
The ball has found the edge of the bat but does not carry to slip.

Slows this through the air, MG lunges forward, plays it with an open face of the bat and guides it past slip to third man. The batsmen take the single, Guptill wants the second but is sent back. One good thing with Guptill's technique today is that he has looked to come forward. He has gone back only when he has been forced to.
On middle and leg, Latham goes back and works it through square leg for a run.
A touch shorter now, Martin goes back and works it through mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up again, outside off, pushed back to the bowler.
Full and outside off, Guptill lunges and defends.
A forward defense to end the over.
Comes down the track and blocks.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Full and outside off, well defended.
FOUR! Runs are leaking now. Fuller in length, Latham goes back and works it through mid-wicket. Long on is pretty wide but he still cannot cut it off.
Short and on middle, Guptill goes back and punches it dangerously through point. A second late and he would have missed it. A single taken.
Goes back and punches it down to long on for one.
Goes back and punches it wide of mid-wicket for a run.
The batsman has driven it through mid on for a single.
On middle, worked behind square leg for a single.
FOUR! Fine shot. Full and outside off, Latham leans and drives it through the covers. Umesh Yadav gives it a good chase, gets to the ball, slides but is unable to pull it back. The ball goes through.
Full on middle and leg, flicked through mid-wicket for a couple.
SIX! Martin Guptill special! Tossed up outside off, Guptill in his trademark style, clears his front leg and lofts it over the long off region. The ball goes for a biggie all the way.
FOUR! Poor ball, punished! Short ball on middle and off, Guptill goes onto his back foot and pulls it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Tossed up around off, Guptill defends it off his front foot.
Landed around off, Guptill goes back in his crease and defends.

CLOSE! Fullish on middle and off, Latham flicks it towards mid-wicket and sets off. Umesh Yadav collects the ball and fires in his throw at the non-striker's end but misses his shy. Had there been a direct hit, it would have been really close. The batsmen take a quick single.
Tossed up outside off, Latham gets onto his front foot and defends.
Tossed up ball outside off, Guptill defends it solidly yet again.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Tossed up on off, Martin defends it solidly.
Landed around off, Guptill gets onto his front foot and defends.
APPEAL FOR AN LBW! Flighted outside off, turning in, Guptill tries to defend but misses and gets hit on the pads. The umpire turns down the appeal. It looked close though.
Flighted on off, Latham strides forward and flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.

DRINKS BREAK! Really good start by New Zealand here. They didn't lose a single wicket in this hour and are off to a positive start. Guptill and Latham survived some scares and would be looking to make India pay now.
BEATEN! Turn and bounce there! Tossed up outside off, spins away as Guptill tries to defend. The Kiwi is beaten by the turn and bounce.
Full on off, driven back to the bowler.
Tossed up ball around off, Guptill defends it solidly yet again.
Tad short on off, Guptill punches it away off his back foot.
Landed outside off, Guptill gets onto his front foot and defends.
Tossed up on off, Martin defends it with soft hands.
Around off, Tom covers the line and defends.
The ball is too wide on the off side for the batsman to make any contact.
BEATEN! Flighted ball outside off, turning away, Latham fails to put his bat on the ball.
Flighted outside off, Latham covers the line and defends.
On middle and leg, Guptill tries to defend but there is some extra bounce. The ball beats his inside edge and goes off the pads. The ball lobs up over leg slip and the batsmen take a leg bye.
Flighted ball around off, Guptill drives it back to the bowler.
RAVICHANDRAN ASHWIN to bowl now. Spin from both the ends.
Landed around off, Latham defends it with soft hands.
FOUR! Nicely played! Tossed up ball around off, Latham sweeps it through the square leg region. The ball races away to the fence in no time.
Tossed up on off, Latham blocks it out off his front foot.
The batsman plays a sweep shot.
Landed outside off, Latham tries to sweep but misses and gets hit on the pads.
Tossed up ball outside off, Latham gets onto his front foot and defends.
RAVINDRA JADEJA into the attack!
Full on off, Guptill drives it towards mid off.
Landed around off, Guptill gets onto his front foot and defends.
Landed outside off, Latham pushes it through covers for a single.

DROPPED! That's a tough chance though! On middle and off, Latham flicks it towards mid-wicket where Jadeja is fielding. The ball goes towards him and Jadeja moves to his left and tries to grab it but it's very low. He fails to collect it cleanly and Latham gets a life now. It was really tough and not quite sure if it was a drop.
Length ball on off, Latham works it towards the leg side.
Landed outside off, Guptill pushes it towards the point region. Single taken. FIFTY UP FOR NEW ZEALAND!
Shami is having a chat with his captain. There is a silly point in place.
Short of a length ball outside off now, Latham tries to cut but gets a bottom edge to the keeper behind.
Fuller length ball outside off, Latham drives it back to the bowler. Yadav tries to stop it but only manages to parry it towards mid on. That was a good shot though.
Fuller length ball outside off, Latham allows it through.
Good length ball on off, Tom defends it solidly from within his crease.
On the pads, Guptill flicks it through square leg for a single.
Good length ball on off, Guptill covers the line and defends.
Landed around the off stump line, Latham defends it into the ground.
Good length ball on off, Latham defends solidly off his front foot.
Landed outside off, Guptill taps it to mid off for a quick single.
Good length ball on off, Martin covers the line and defends.
Fuller length ball on off, Guptill drives it towards mid off.
On the pads, Latham flicks it to long leg for a single.
Fullish around off, Guptill drives it towards mid on.
FOUR! That's a lovely shot! Landed outside off, Guptill punches it through the cover region. Gambhir chases the ball but eventually gives up as the ball wins the race.
Back of a length ball outside off, Tom taps it towards point for a single.
Good length ball on off, Latham blocks it out off his front foot.
Banged in short on middle and off, Latham does well to evade it.
Good length ball around off, Latham leaves it alone.
FOUR! Controlled! Touch fullish outside off, Guptill plays it with soft hands and steers it towards the third man region for a boundary.
Fuller length ball around off, Guptill drives it towards mid off.
On middle and off, Latham flicks it through the leg side for a single.
BEATEN! Fuller length ball around off, angling in, Latham tries to defend but misses it completely. Beautiful bowling!
Length ball on off, Latham defends it from within his crease.
Fuller length ball outside off, Latham defends it off his front foot.
Good length on off, Guptill defends it off his back foot.
Fullish on off, angling in towards the batsman, Latham flicks it through square leg for a single.
Banged in short around off, angling in and goes over Latham's head who ducks under it quickly.
In the corridor outside off, Tom lets it go through.
Good length ball on off, Latham covers the line and defends.
Good length ball outside off, Latham shoulders his arms.
Landed around off, Guptill defends it into the ground.
Fuller length ball outside off, Guptill drives it back to the bowler. Shami parries it towards covers.
Good length ball on off, Martin defends it from within his crease.
Landed outside off, Guptill defends it from within his crease.

DROPPED! Fuller length ball outside off, Guptill is tempted and goes for the big booming drive through the off side. No footwork there and he gets a thick outside edge. The ball flies towards Rahane at wide second slip where he drops the catch. He should have taken that one. Guptill gets a life.
Fuller length ball on off, angling in, Guptill defends it into the ground.

Interesting. Gautam Gambhir was standing at normal mid-wicket position while Virat Kohli was standing at short mid-wicket. Now, Kohli moves in to a silly mid on position while Gambhir has come in at short mid-wicket.
Back of a length ball on off, Latham tries to play from inside the line but misses as the ball goes past his outside edge.
On the pads, Latham flicks it towards the fine leg region. Three runs taken.
Length ball on off, Latham pushes it to the point region.
Fuller length ball around off, Latham lets it go through.
Landed outside off, Latham shoulders his arms.
Good length ball on middle and off, Latham tries to play it across but gets a bit of a leading edge.
Length ball on off, Guptill flicks it to the mid-wicket region.
Landed around the off stump channel, Guptill defends it from within his crease.
Fuller length ball outside off, Latham drives it to covers where Gambhir dives to stop the ball. Pretty good effort that. Single taken.
Landed outside off, Latham pushes it to the cover region.
Fullish ball around off, Latham flicks it towards mid-wicket.
Good length ball outside off, angling in, Latham lets it go through.
MOHAMMED SHAMI to bowl from the other end. Guess what? The ball has lost its shape once again. We've seen this many a time in this Test.

EDGED! FOUR!  Fuller length ball outside off, Guptill pokes at it but gets a thick outside edge. Rahane from second slip dives to his right but fails to stop the ball which goes past the fence eventually.
Good length ball around off, Guptill covers the line and defends.
Fuller length ball on off, Guptill drives it towards the mid on region.
Fullish outside off, Martin shoulders his arms.
On the pads, Guptill tries to play it across but misses. He is hit on the pads and there is an appeal for a leg before but the umpire says not out. It was going down the leg side.
Landed around off, Guptill drives it uppishly to mid on.
The players are out in the middle. The Indian players pose for the team photograph. MARTIN GUPTILL and TOM LATHAM stride out. There's an Indian team huddle. UMESH YADAV to bowl first up. Here we go!
PITCH REPORT - Sunil Gavaskar reckons it's still a good pitch to bat on. There are some cracks and it's a hard surface. If the batsmen apply themselves then they can score runs.

Hello everyone to the coverage of day 3 of the third Test between India and New Zealand in Indore. The hosts are firmly in control in this Test as well after a mammoth first innings total. New Zealand played out the tricky little period towards the end as they didn't lose a single wicket. It's going to be a big day for the visitors here as they are trailing by 529 runs and they need to bat really, really well here. Should be an exciting day of Test cricket!
... Day 3, Session 1...

New Zealand have a mountain to climb here. They're trailing by a big margin and they would look to plan things session-by-session. Let's see what do we have in store tomorrow. Join us back at 0930 then to catch all the day 3 action. Goodbye and take care. Cheers!

Wonderful day for India! They would have liked a wicket at least of New Zealand by stumps but they won't mind this either. The Kohli-Rahane partnership took India to a mammoth total first and towards the end, Rohit Sharma chipped in with an unbeaten fifty. The Indian captain hit his second double ton whereas Rahane missed out as he fell short of his maiden double ton by 12 runs.
Short and flat around off, Martin Guptill rocks onto his back foot and pulls it through to deep mid-wicket for a single. And with that, IT WILL BE STUMPS ON DAY 2!
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Presses forward now again only to block.
SIX! Isn't afraid to attack and takes on the flight. Gets down and slog sweeps this over the mid-wicket boundary for a maximum.
Fullish and loopy around off, it's pushed down to mid off.
Carrom ball from Ashwin, but it's too short to cause Martin Guptill any trouble. He has all the time in the world to get back and keep it out.
This is worked towards mid-wicket. No run taken.
The southpaw opener once again takes a big stride ahead and buries it.
Tom Latham comes out to this tossed up delivery and meets the ball only to smother it into the track.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. They pick up a single.
Arm ball outside off, the ball hold its line and Latham guides it down to third man from deep within the crease. One run taken.
Some serious rip for Jadeja on this occasion. Spins back in and beats the inside edge to hit him on the thigh pad.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Once again Guptill gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Tossed up loopy off-spinner around off, Guptill is rapped on the front pad as he comes forward to block. Think there was an inside edge there as well.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Flights this up well, Ashwin. Bowls it full and on the stumps, Martin Guptill drives it down to long on for a single.
Loopy and shorter outside off, Martin plays this to point for no run.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Tom Latham once again comes a bit forward but only to block it once more.
Tom Latham goes deep inside the crease, stands tall and buries this delivery into the track.
Full and fired in on middle and off, Latham takes a big stride forward and keeps it out.
Flatter, shorter and turning in on middle and leg, it's defended from deep within the crease.
Flatter ball on middle and off, kept out off the front foot.
RAVINDRA JADEJA comes on to bowl now.
Guptill gets behind the line to defend.
Closer to the off stump this time, turning in, a solid forward block.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Floated well and in the channel outside off, Guptill walks across and works it to mid-wicket.
This is good bowling by Ravi Ashwin. Immediately pitches it in the right areas. Loops it up around off, Guptill presses forward and pushes it to covers.
Tossed up on the stumps, hit back to the bowler.
RAVICHANDRAN ASHWIN comes on to bowl.
Going down leg, the southpaw looks to go after it but misses.
IN THE AIR... BUT IT FALLS SAFELY! Length ball tailing in on the pads, Latham uppishly flicks this towards mid-wicket. It's in the air for quite a while but it still falls safely. Two runs taken.
Back of a length outside off, defended off the back foot.
Coming in on middle and leg, nudged away to the on side for no run.
Back of a length delivery on middle and leg, Tom is cramped for room as he hops and works it towards Kohli at mid-wicket.
Fuller length ball from Umesh Yadav, around off, Latham stands his ground and blocks with a straight bat.
We are going to have another ball change. Once again the ball is out of shape and the umpires have called for a different ball.
Over the wicket, Guptill presents a tight defensive shot to this length delivery and keeps it out.
Angling down the leg side, Tom works it behind square on the leg side for a single.
Shami pitches it very full and looks for the swing on offer, it doesn't move much as the left-hander leaves it alone.
On a length this time, outside off, there's some extra bounce as Tom Latham gets big, stays behind the line and taps it down into the track.
Fullish in length once more and pitched outside off, Latham comes forward and keeps it out with a solid defensive shot.
Comes steaming in from around the wicket, Latham leans forward and shoulders his arms to it.
On middle and off, Guptill flicks it to mid-wicket. There is a fielder.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
In the corridor outside off, Martin shoulders his arms.
Length ball on off, Guptill covers the line and defends.
FOUR! Fullish on the pads, Guptill flicks it through the square leg region for another boundary. Poor ball, that.
Fuller length ball on off, Latham gets an inside edge onto his pads. Latham quickly takes a quick single.
UMESH YADAV to bowl from the other end.
Fullish ball on off, Guptill drives it to mid on.
FOUR! Guptill is off the mark! Landed outside off, Martin plays it through the point region. The ball goes through the gap and Guptill gets a boundary.
Fuller length ball on off, Guptill drives it towards mid on.
Length ball on off, Guptill defends it with soft hands.
Fullish ball on off, Guptill drives it towards mid off.
Length ball on middle and off, Guptill defends it from within his crease.
